account-locked: Daro wode gelanau paacci balettido gishshau akkawuntiyaa guutha wodiyau qolfettiis. Guyyiyan zaarettada paacca.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel SuperAdmin xalaassas, Cloud Panel domeeniyan.
cloud-settings-desc: Weddy giddon de'iya WeKan-aara, Cloud Panel issi sarveriyaappe daro WeKan domeenata oottees, ubbaykka ba data de'ees. Cloud Panel domeeniyan, SuperAdmin domeenatanne CloudFlare ayssees.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: CloudFlare API qulfiyaara, ba zoonee ne CloudFlare akaawuntiyan de'iya domeenay proxy DNS maxaafaanne CloudFlare Origin markkattaa ekkees. Harai domeenati Let's Encrypt markkattaa ekkoosona. Qulfee sarveriyan naagettees, zaarettidi mule bessettenna.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: CloudFlare API qulfee naagettibeenna: ubba domeenay Let's Encrypt markkattaa ekkees.
error-notAuthorized: Ha sinttaa be'anaw nees maati baawa.
